title: Closing Cost Credit Combination and Cost Category Table
content:
On a Larkspur loan file the Larkspur Closing Cost Credit programs combine, fill costs and are funded according to the program terms below.

### Cost categories, application position and funding

| Credit program | Closing Disclosure cost categories it may pay, in the order they are filled | Application position (1 is applied first) | Funded by | Counted as an interested party contribution with seller and agent concessions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | nonrecurring closing costs, then prepaid items | 5 | Larkspur | no |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | nonrecurring closing costs | 6 | Larkspur | no |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | nonrecurring closing costs, then prepaid items, then down payment | 3 | Larkspur | no |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | nonrecurring closing costs, then prepaid items | 7 | Larkspur | no |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | nonrecurring closing costs, then discount points, then buydown subsidy, then prepaid items | 4 | builder | yes |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | nonrecurring closing costs, then prepaid items, then down payment | 2 | Larkspur | no |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | down payment, then nonrecurring closing costs, then prepaid items | 1 | Larkspur | no |

### Combination terms

| Credit program | Exclusive group | Programs it may be combined with on one loan file | Unused credit paid in cash | Credit that finds no eligible cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | none | Larkspur First Home Credit, Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee, Larkspur Builder Partner Credit, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | no | forfeited |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | none | Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | no | forfeited |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | none | Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | no | forfeited |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | none | Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, Larkspur Returning Customer Credit, Larkspur First Home Credit, Larkspur Builder Partner Credit, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | no | forfeited |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | none | Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | no | forfeited |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | neighborhood | Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, Larkspur First Home Credit, Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | no | forfeited |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | neighborhood | Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | no | forfeited |

### How to read a pair

Hypothetical pairs read from the table, showing whether each program of the pair lists the other and whether the two share an exclusive group:

| Pair | Listed both ways | Same exclusive group |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur First Home Credit with Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | yes | no (none and neighborhood) |
| Larkspur First Home Credit with Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | no — the Plus does not list the Larkspur First Home Credit | no |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit with Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | no — neither lists the other | no |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant with Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | no | yes (neighborhood) |

The application position orders the credits on one Closing Disclosure, the lowest number first; the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus is always first and the Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee always last.
